race.comment: ADMIRE ME (3) worked home evenly but never looked a threat when third last start over 1300m at this track, her first appearance in around six months. Strips fitter and should enjoy getting out to the mile for the first time. ENDLESS APPLAUSE (4) has raced well without winning in her four runs this prep. Made up plenty of late ground to get up for second last time out over this trip at Moree. Rock-hard fit and maps beautifully out of the inside alley. SMART SCUD (1) made a sustained run from mid-race and cleared right away for an authoritative victory over this distance at Dubbo recently. Getting up in the weights but he is lightly raced and open to further improvement. THINK BACK (2) failed twice as favourite but repaid supporters last start with a dogged all-the-way win over 1400m at Moree. Goes well here and can run out a strong mile. VELIA (5) is very hit and miss but capable of testing this field if in the mood.
